food_bismillah_awwalihi.title: Bismillah — If Forgotten at the Start
food_bismillah_awwalihi.translation: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and at its end.
food_bismillah_awwalihi.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) taught: mention Allah's name when you begin eating; if you forget, say this when you remember, so the whole meal is blessed.
food_bismillah_awwalihi.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 3/347, At-Tirmidhi 4/288; Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/167 | Hisnul Muslim 178
food_bismillah_awwalihi.occasion: Recite when you remember that you forgot Bismillah before eating.

food_barik_lana_fihi.title: When Given Food or Milk
food_barik_lana_fihi.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
food_barik_lana_fihi.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa aṭ'imnā khayran minhu. Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minhu
food_barik_lana_fihi.translation: O Allah, bless us in it and feed us with what is better than it. (When given milk:) O Allah, bless us in it and give us more of it.
food_barik_lana_fihi.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) taught to ask Allah for blessing in the food He provides and for something better, and when drinking milk to ask for blessing and increase.
food_barik_lana_fihi.reference: Jami' At-Tirmidhi 5/506; Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/158 | Hisnul Muslim 179
food_barik_lana_fihi.occasion: Recite when food is served to you; the second wording when given milk.

food_alhamdulillah_ataani.title: After Eating — Sins Forgiven
food_alhamdulillah_ataani.arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
food_alhamdulillah_ataani.transliteration: Alḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī aṭ'amanī hādhā wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah
food_alhamdulillah_ataani.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me, without any might or power on my part.
food_alhamdulillah_ataani.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) said that whoever says this after eating will have his past sins forgiven.
food_alhamdulillah_ataani.reference: At-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah; Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/159 | Hisnul Muslim 180

food_alhamdulillah_kathiran.title: After Eating — Abundant Praise
food_alhamdulillah_kathiran.arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
food_alhamdulillah_kathiran.transliteration: Alḥamdu lillāhi ḥamdan kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīhi, ghayra makfiyyin wa lā muwadda'in wa lā mustaghnan 'anhu Rabbanā
food_alhamdulillah_kathiran.translation: All praise is for Allah — abundant, pure and blessed praise; a praise that can never suffice Him, nor be abandoned, nor be dispensed with, our Lord.
food_alhamdulillah_kathiran.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) would praise Allah with these words when his food was cleared away. Recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari.
food_alhamdulillah_kathiran.occasion: Recite when the meal is finished.

food_dua_for_host.title: Guest's Du'a for the Host
food_dua_for_host.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
food_dua_for_host.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lahum fīmā razaqtahum, waghfir lahum, warḥamhum
food_dua_for_host.translation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, forgive them and have mercy on them.
food_dua_for_host.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) supplicated with these words for a family who served him food — repaying hospitality with blessing, forgiveness and mercy.
food_dua_for_host.occasion: Recite for your host after eating at their home.

food_atim_man_atamani.title: For the One Who Feeds You
food_atim_man_atamani.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
food_atim_man_atamani.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭ'im man aṭ'amanī, wasqi man saqānī
food_atim_man_atamani.translation: O Allah, feed the one who fed me and give drink to the one who gave me drink.
food_atim_man_atamani.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) made this dua for the one who gave him food and drink, asking Allah to repay their kindness.
food_atim_man_atamani.occasion: Recite for whoever gives you food or drink.

food_breaking_fast.title: When Breaking the Fast
food_breaking_fast.arabicText: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
food_breaking_fast.transliteration: Dhahaba-ẓ-ẓama'u wabtallatil-'urūqu, wa thabatal-ajru in shā' Allāh
food_breaking_fast.translation: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
food_breaking_fast.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) would say this upon breaking his fast, and the dua of the fasting person at iftar is not rejected.
food_breaking_fast.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 2/306; Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 4/209 | Hisnul Muslim 176
food_breaking_fast.occasion: Recite when breaking your fast at sunset.

food_breaking_fast_forgiveness.title: At Iftar — Asking Forgiveness
food_breaking_fast_forgiveness.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
food_breaking_fast_forgiveness.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka bi-raḥmatika-llatī wasi'at kulla shay'in an taghfira lī
food_breaking_fast_forgiveness.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which embraces all things, to forgive me.
food_breaking_fast_forgiveness.benefit: Abdullah ibn Amr (may Allah be pleased with him) would say this at the time of breaking the fast, a moment when dua is accepted.
food_breaking_fast_forgiveness.reference: Sunan Ibn Majah 1/557; graded good by Al-Hafidh Ibn Hajar | Hisnul Muslim 177
food_breaking_fast_forgiveness.occasion: Recite at the moment of breaking your fast.

food_aftara_indakum.title: Breaking Fast at Someone's Home
food_aftara_indakum.arabicText: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
food_aftara_indakum.transliteration: Afṭara 'indakumu-ṣ-ṣā'imūn, wa akala ṭa'āmakumul-abrār, wa ṣallat 'alaykumul-malā'ikah
food_aftara_indakum.translation: May the fasting break their fast with you, may the righteous eat your food, and may the angels send blessings upon you.
food_aftara_indakum.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) blessed his hosts with this dua after breaking fast at their home.
food_aftara_indakum.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 3/367, Ibn Majah 1/556; Sahih Abu Dawud 2/730 | Hisnul Muslim 184
food_aftara_indakum.occasion: Recite when you break your fast as a guest.
